abstract: # C-reactive protein test - Mayo Clinic. *   Health Library  Diseases & Conditions  Symptoms  Tests & Procedures    Drugs & Supplements  Healthy Lifestyle  Mayo Clinic Health Letter & Books    Mayo Clinic Health Letter &Books     Image 3. A simple blood test can check your C-reactive protein level. A high-sensitivity C-reactive protein test, also called hs-CRP test, is more sensitive than a standard C-reactive protein test. The hs-CRP test can help show the risk of getting coronary artery disease. ### A note about C-reactive protein tests for heart disease. A high level of hs-CRP in the blood has been linked to an increased risk of heart attacks. For example, if you're having an hs-CRP test to check for heart disease, you also might have a cholesterol test at the same time. A coronary artery disease risk assessment usually is based on the average of two hs-CRP tests. Having a high hs-CRP level doesn't always mean a higher risk of developing heart disease.
